listed_sector_signals.signal: Cross-citation in the AIP 'Articles You May Be Interested In' list referencing ISO 50001 energy management implementation at a cement company (Pt Semen Tonasa)
listed_sector_signals.quote: Implementation of energy management system ISO 50001:2011 in Pt Semen Tonasa: Sharing experience

one_line: The paper proposes and demonstrates a modular system model for energy-efficiency monitoring of factory supply systems (an industrial cooling system with cooling tower, chiller and pumps) in discrete manufacturing, not a continuous-flow production process; the only cement reference is an unrelated AIP cross-citation.
